appservice.js checkPluginInfo fail with error: Error: project.config.json: libVersion 字段需为 string, string
simulator game launch error TypeError: Cannot read property 'getPreCompileOptions' of undefined
defect.whyNoGateCaughtIt: The Cocos build itself does not validate this field, so build:wx stayed PASS while the package could not be launched in the DevTools at all.
defect.regressionEvidence: The repo's earlier Three.js build (legacy/threejs-prototype/platform/wx/project.config.json, tracked) uses "libVersion": "3.3.4", which is valid - so this was introduced by the port to Cocos.

fix.mergeSemantics: deep JSON merge - verified by the existing partial cocos/build-templates/wechatgame/game.json, which keeps the template's networkTimeout in the built output
gates: scripts/verify_cocos_minigame_builds.mjs -> isValidLibVersion(project.libVersion) asserted on the real build output
